verdict.rationale: PostHog's experiments docs say you define variants, pick the metrics you care about, and PostHog randomizes users, tracks exposures, and runs Bayesian or frequentist statistics. That covers A/B tests with goal metrics and a statistical engine. The MCP tool inventory also lists a dedicated Experiments category. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how significance and confidence are shown on the results view, and independent or hands-on corroboration of experiment results.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can run A/B experiments with goal metrics and statistical significance reported on the results

citations.quote: You define variants, pick the metrics you care about, and PostHog randomizes your users, tracks their exposures, and runs the statistics – Bayesian or frequentist – so you get a real answer instead of a hunch.
